This page lists the main changes to ArenaLytics, newest first. The About page
of the dashboard shows the most recent ones.

## In the pipeline

- Handling of additional complex surveys, panelization and ratio estimators.
- Use-case demonstrations.

## October 2026

- New analysis setup: separate steps to select the inputs and configure the
  analysis, with switches and dimension chips.
- Category dimensions keep the order defined in the survey in tables, figures
  and filters.
- Updated package dependencies for online deployment.

## September 2026

- Category labels are now matched when a taxonomy name is missing from the
  survey schema.

## August 2026

- ZIP files without taxonomies can be analysed.
- Labels of hierarchical categories are matched at every level.
- Deployment on Posit Connect Cloud.
- Offline installation bundle, including Windows binaries, and documentation
  website.
